rationale: The candidate is a coherent small mass in all four views and remains inside the parcel, so it clears basic containment and cross-view coherence. However, it reads as a generic compact box with a slight cantilever-like step, not as a neighborhood-living mass with a meaningful public ground figure. The blue access edge is answered only weakly: there is no convincing court, notch, undercut, or entry seam oriented to the frontage. The silhouette is not especially broken or contradictory, but it is also not sectional enough for the program; the upper mass is calm, yet the ground does not become active. Compared with the references, it has only a faint resonance with compact commercial street buildings and none of the stronger courtyard/threshold logics. Because the visible mass lacks a legible public void and an active street threshold, program fit fails.
